schema_description: The openEHR Reference Model 1.2.0 as openehr-sdk-go generates it: the pinned openehr_rm_1.2.0 schema, with the corrections it lacks until a re-pin carries them.

TRANSLATION_DETAILS.name: TRANSLATION_DETAILS
TRANSLATION_DETAILS.documentation:
Class providing details of a natural language translation.

Reason: the RM schema misspells the name of the accreditation property, which the openEHR BASE, ITS-XML and ITS-JSON schemas spell accreditation, so the class is declared again whole under that name. Upstream: https://github.com/openEHR/specifications-RM/pull/43.

Reason: unchanged; declared again with its class. Upstream: openehr_rm_1.2.0.

author.documentation:

Reason: unchanged; declared again with its class. Upstream: openehr_rm_1.2.0.

accreditation.name: accreditation
accreditation.documentation:
Accreditation of translator, usually a national translator's registration or association membership id.

Reason: the RM schema misspells this name; the openEHR BASE, ITS-XML and ITS-JSON schemas spell it accreditation. Upstream: https://github.com/openEHR/specifications-RM/pull/43.
